title: Local fibre-Cartier criterion for a locally principal subscheme
statement: Let φ:X\to S be a flat morphism locally of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let Z be a locally principal closed subscheme of X [def-sc-effective-cartier-divisor], and let x\in Z with image s\in S. If the fibre Z_s\subseteq X_s is an effective Cartier divisor [def-sc-effective-cartier-divisor] in a neighbourhood of x, then there is an open neighbourhood U of x such that Z\cap U is a relative effective Cartier divisor [def-pc-relative-effective-cartier] on U over S.
